question:
**Select the most appropriate word which means the same as the group of words given.**

Something that is given to counter the effect of poison
solution:
The correct answer is '**Antidote**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Antidote**'.
 
• It means 'a medical substance that is used to prevent a poison or a disease from having an effect'. (विषहर औषधि)
 
 
• *Example: There is no **antidote** to this poison.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Antidote.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Artichoke**: a green vegetable with a lot of thick pointed leaves. You can eat the bottom part of the leaves and its center. [हाथीचक, वज्रांगी (एक वनस्‍पति)]
 
• **Medicine**: the science of preventing and treating illness. (रोग की रोकथाम और उपचार का शास्‍त्र, चिकित्‍सा-शास्‍त्र)
 
• **Antibiotic**: a medicine that is used for destroying bacteria and curing infections. (जीवाणुनाशक औषधि; प्रतिजैविक)
